in_sanskrit.name: Aditya
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lord of the Sun, Radiant One, Invincible One

in_marathi.name: Adity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adity हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aditya is the name of the sun god in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'aditya', which means 'sun'. Aditya is considered to be the god of light, knowledge, and power. He is also believed to be the source of all energy and the giver of life.
